q: For a subshift of finite type X_A with irreducible transition matrix A, the unique measure of maximal entropy (Parry measure) gives weights to cylinder sets proportional to:
opts: Left Perron eigenvectors × right Perron eigenvectors × λ^{-n}
The number of paths of length n
exp: The Parry measure: μ([w₀w₁…wₙ]) = uᵢ vⱼ λ^{-n} where u,v are left/right Perron eigenvectors of A and λ is the Perron eigenvalue. This gives h_μ = log λ = h_top, achieving the variational principle.
